exercises.title: 九年级 U12 听力·对话 A Bad Morning
exercises.speaker: us_male
transcript: W: You look tired. What happened this morning?
M: I overslept. By the time I woke up, it was nine o'clock.
W: Oh no! Did you miss the bus?
M: Yes. By the time I got to the stop, the bus had already left.
W: What a morning! At least you're here now.
exercises.translation_cn:
女:你看起来很累。今早怎么了?
男:我睡过头了。等我醒来,已经九点了。
女:糟糕!你错过公交车了吗?
男:是的。等我到站时,车已经开走了。
女:真是个糟糕的早晨!至少你现在到了。

questions.stem: Why does the man look tired?
What time did the man wake up?
What had happened when he got to the bus stop?
Did the man miss the bus?
Is the man at work now?
options: He is still on the bus.

exercises.title: 九年级 U12 听力·短文 The Radio Hoax
exercises.speaker: us_female
transcript: In 1938, a radio show in the US told a strange story.
It announced that aliens had landed on Earth.
Many people thought it was real news.
By the time they learned the truth, they had become frightened.
The show was a famous hoax.
exercises.translation_cn:
1938年,美国一档广播节目讲了一个奇怪的故事。
它宣布外星人已经在地球着陆。
许多人以为那是真实的新闻。
等他们得知真相时,已经吓坏了。
那档节目是一个著名的骗局。

questions.stem: When did the radio show happen?
What did the show announce?
What did many people think?
How did people feel by the time they learned the truth?
What was the show?

exercises.title: 九年级 U12 听力·对话 The Costume Mistake
exercises.speaker: us_male
transcript: W: Why are you wearing a costume?
M: There's a costume party today. Didn't you know?
W: A costume party? No one told me about that.
M: Wait... everyone is in normal clothes. April Fool!
W: Oh no! You fooled me. How embarrassing!
exercises.translation_cn:
女:你为什么穿着化装服?
男:今天有化装舞会啊。你不知道吗?
女:化装舞会?没人告诉我。
男:等等……大家都穿着普通衣服。愚人节快乐!
女:不好!你耍了我。太尴尬了!

questions.stem: Why is the man wearing a costume?
options: He thinks there's a costume party.
questions.answer_text: He thinks there's a costume party.

questions.stem: Did anyone tell the woman about the party?
What are the other people wearing?
What day is it?
How does the woman feel?

exercises.title: 九年级 U12 听力·短文 April Fool's Day
exercises.speaker: us_female
transcript: April Fool's Day is on April 1st.
On this day, people play jokes on each other.
The jokes are meant to be funny, not unkind.
No one knows for sure how the day began.
By the end of the day, people tell the truth about their jokes.
exercises.translation_cn:
愚人节是4月1日。
这一天,人们互相开玩笑。
这些玩笑是为了好玩,而不是不友善。
没人确切知道这个节日是怎么开始的。
到这一天结束时,人们会说出玩笑的真相。

questions.stem: When is April Fool's Day?
What do people do on this day?
What are the jokes meant to be?
Does anyone know how the day began?
What do people do by the end of the day?
options: Tell the truth about their jokes.
questions.answer_text: Tell the truth about their jokes.

exercises.title: 九年级 U12 听力·对话 The Lost Backpack
exercises.speaker: us_male
transcript: W: You look worried. What's wrong?
M: I left my backpack on the bus this morning.
W: Oh no! Was anything important inside?
M: Yes, my keys and phone. But the bus company called.
W: Did they find it? That's great news!
exercises.translation_cn:
女:你看起来很担心。怎么了?
男:我今早把背包落在公交车上了。
女:不好!里面有重要东西吗?
男:有,我的钥匙和手机。不过公交公司打来电话了。
女:他们找到了吗?那太好了!

questions.stem: Why does the man look worried?
options: He lost his keys at home.
He left his backpack on the bus.
questions.answer_text: He left his backpack on the bus.

questions.stem: When did he leave it?
What was inside the backpack?
Who called the man?
How does the woman react?

exercises.title: 九年级 U12 听力·短文 School April Fool's Rules
exercises.speaker: us_female
transcript: On April 1st, our school will have a fun day.
You may play kind and safe jokes on your friends.
Do not hurt or scare anyone.
At lunch, you may wear a funny costume.
By the end of the day, tell your friends the truth.
exercises.translation_cn:
4月1日,我们学校将有一个有趣的日子。
你可以和朋友开友善又安全的玩笑。
不要伤害或吓唬任何人。
午餐时,你可以穿有趣的化装服。
到这一天结束时,告诉朋友真相。

questions.stem: When is the fun day?
What kind of jokes can you play?
What should you not do?
What can you wear at lunch?
What should you do by the end of the day?
